description: Opaque id: the entity's three-letter prefix (entities.json) plus 10 lowercase Crockford base32 characters.
Id of a registry item (a Term, Unit, Dimension, SpecDefinition or Category).
UTC timestamp taken from the clock (ISO 8601, Z suffix).
Who made a change or filed a proposal: a person (the founder or a reader), an agent, or an import.
How a search ranked its products: by the words they hold, or, when no word matched, by closeness in meaning.
Where a proposal stands in the review queue: waiting, applied, refused, or undone after it was applied.
What the review queue's audit log records done to a proposal.
What a proposal of a bundle does to the records the store holds, riskiest first: withdraws one, changes one, or only adds.
The event that files a proposal: a record added, changed, merged or withdrawn, a reader's report, a quality check, a news draft, a rollback.
An AI use in the system: ask, research, its image judge, datasheet extraction, news drafting, or all uses together.
What an outside agent token permits: reading catalog data, or reading and proposing changes.
Where an agent token stands: active, expired past its date, or revoked by the founder.
What a research run reads: one product's pages, one maker's, or those of each maker in a category.

Where a research run stands: running; done, every page in reach read; partial, its page or time budget spent with pages left; blocked, no page in reach read; stopped by the founder, stopped by an AI cap, or failed.
One step of a research run: a page or file read or skipped, a proposal filed, rejected, or run ended.
BCP-47 language tag to text; en is required and is the fallback.
Calendar date with an explicit precision, so no date claims more exactness than its source.

value.description: YYYY, YYYY-H1|H2, YYYY-Q1..Q4, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, matching precision

description: One item of a closed vocabulary in data/registry/.

public.description: media_rights: files under this right may be served publicly

mime_types.description: document_kinds: the mime types (or prefixes such as image/) a file of this kind may have

version.description: document_kinds: a file of this kind is about a ProductVersion and must name it in its subjects

sets_status.description: lifecycle_event_types: an occurred event of this type becomes the product's displayed status

names_successor.description: lifecycle_event_types: an event of this type, and only such an event, names a successor, which a sourced relation of a type marked succeeds ties to the product

occurred.description: lifecycle_event_states: an event in this state has happened, so it can set the displayed status and needs no state badge

expected.description: lifecycle_event_states: an event in this state is still to come: it may be dated in the future when a cited source was published, and is overdue once its date has passed

superseded.description: lifecycle_event_states: an event in this state names, in revised_by, the event of the same product and type that revises it

vendor_document.description: source_types: a document the maker publishes about its product; a value it backs is datasheet-grade

preference.description: source_types: how a source of this type ranks for the one source a page shows beside a value, 1 first; then the newest, then the smallest id

files_on.description: proposal_kinds: the event that files a proposal of this kind

research.description: source_types: a page a research run reads on the maker's sites (its own, its group's, the product's) is a Source of this type; media_rights: a file it finds is proposed under this right; document_kinds: a file of this kind it finds is read for the values it states, as a Source of the source type and by the claim method of the kind's id

hosts.description: source_types: a page or file a research run reads off the maker's sites, on one of these hosts or under one, is a Source of this type

third_party.description: source_types: a page or file a research run reads off the maker's sites, on no type's hosts, is a Source of this type

succeeds.description: relation_types: a relation of this type says its from_entity replaces its to_entity, its successor

owns.description: org_relation_types: a relation of this type makes its to_org the owner of its from_org, from its valid_from until its valid_to

renames.description: org_relation_types: a relation of this type says its from_org is its to_org under a new name, from its valid_from: one organization, named as it was called that day

pattern.description: identifier_schemes: a value is the whole of this regex

subjects.description: identifier_schemes: the entity kinds a value of this scheme identifies

gs1_check.description: identifier_schemes: a value's last digit is its GS1 check digit

names_product.description: identifier_schemes: a value names one product of its maker, so two of its products sharing one are one product

schema_org.description: identifier_schemes: the schema.org Product property a value of this scheme is

vendor_for_view.description: product_org_roles: the order in which an organization of this role is a product's vendor on its page, 1 first; a role without it never is

from_side.description: relation_types: how a relation of this type reads on its from_entity's page

to_side.description: relation_types: how it reads on its to_entity's page

description: One side of a relation type: the label a product's page lists the related products under, and the schema.org Product property it maps to.
Price with ISO 4217 currency and the date it was observed.
Usage metering of an Offering: included quantity of a unit per period.
One sentence of a news article and what it rests on: at least one product, organization or source.
A measured value in a registry unit.
A measured range, from min to max, in a registry unit.
Set of ProductVersions of one product, ordered by the version's scheme.
Value of a Claim, tagged by kind: a quantity or a range for a quantity spec, a term, terms, a boolean or a string; or none, with the reason (absence_reasons) a source gives for having no value.
One step of a Change: add, replace or remove the value at a field path (e.g. specs.frame_rate or name).

value.description: The new value as JSON text; absent for remove
